verdict: Mr. Badar Sami looks like he personally enjoys ignoring urgent emails from stressed seniors during finals week.
detailedQuote: Wearing a pitch-black blazer stiffer than his policy on late assignment submissions, this man radiates pure 'I read off 120 unformatted PowerPoint slides' energy. His lifeless white dress shirt serves as a grim reminder that your 79.8% will under no circumstances ever be rounded up.

inventory.name: Black Rectangular Glasses of Zero Grace Period
inventory.description: Generic rectangle specs worn solely to stare blankly at students asking for extension requests before issuing a flat 'No'.

inventory.name: Black Suit Blazer of Emotional Desolation
inventory.description: A dark, dreary suit jacket that has never experienced a dry cleaner or an ounce of joy since 2012.

inventory.name: White Button-Up Shirt of Unanswered Canvas Messages
inventory.description: A plain white collared shirt that screams 'I leave office hours 20 minutes early because I simply do not care'.
